# build time from every other page in this folder, sorted by each page's

  contents: "*.qmd"
  type: table
  sort: "order"
  fields: [title]
  field-display-names:
    title: "Contents"
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  table-striped: false
  table-hover: true
---
